title: Pairing symbols with procedures
description: You can read an association list built from two key-value pairs.

steps.description: ops is an association list, a list of key-value pairs. You build its two entries with cons.
In (cons '+ +), the quoted + is a symbol and the unquoted + is the addition procedure. The subtraction entry follows the same pattern.

steps.question: Does this definition call the addition procedure?
steps.answer: No. It stores the procedure as the value in a pair; cons and list build the data structure.

steps.description: You finish with ops bound to two symbol-procedure pairs. The supplied recording shows no printed value for this definition.
